# NexPlay Repository Instructions

You are working on the NexPlay production repository.

Read `AGENTS.md` before performing significant work.

The following rules are mandatory:

1. Inspect before editing.
2. Never fabricate existing functionality.
3. Make minimal changes.
4. Preserve working behavior.
5. Use strict TypeScript.
6. Protect authentication and authorization.
7. Never trust client-side financial state.
8. Never weaken Firebase security rules.
9. Never expose secrets.
10. Test all meaningful changes.
11. Never claim unexecuted tests passed.
12. Never claim unverified deployment success.
13. Payment and wallet changes require additional financial review.
14. Security-sensitive changes require security review.
15. Database changes require database impact analysis.
16. Prefer existing abstractions over creating duplicates.
17. Do not introduce dependencies without justification.
18. Keep production code free from debugging statements.
19. Document architectural decisions.
20. Stop and ask for clarification when a critical assumption is unknown.

When working in a specific directory, also follow applicable files under:

.github/instructions/

and the nearest applicable `AGENTS.md`.
